title: Synchronisation error - changes NS profile are not correct synched to AndroidAPS
body: Reporting bugs -------------- - I use Beta 8 and on nightscout side 14.0.7. The error occurred at around 10:10 o'clock this morning. Sorry I can't get this information better. - I added a. log file, b. screenshot from ns profile editor and c. screenshot vom AndroidAPS - The error occurred when I switched back from 4 IC values per day to hourly based IC values. Therefore I added in the NS profile editor further entries for every hour and saved the profile. - On ns side the hourly added values are correct but on AndroidAPS there are new entries but the time information is missing and I had to add this manual. - The second issue I see but I don't know where it comes from (NS or AndroidAPS) ist that the timestamp since the profile is in place (gültig in German) is not correct [AndroidAPS_LOG_1638958717120.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7675284/AndroidAPS_LOG_1638958717120.log.zip) ![30db5e6b-e3d6-4ba6-b6a7-6a842e07ba98](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4148261/145192219-bfab76ab-4aa5-4225-8397-18fa785fe26e.jpg) .

comments.body:
did you follow this while setting profile?
https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Installing-AndroidAPS/Releasenotes.html#changes
I think I violated "Record modification from NS is not allowed" when I changed the profile with Nightscout profile editor if I understand this right.

That's part of the release notes. I thought I used a not already implemented functionality.

"NSClient rewritten for better synchronization and more detailed customization @MilosKozak

Record deletion from NS is not allowed (only invalidation through NSClient)
**Record modification from NS is not allowed**
Sync setting available without engineering mode (for parents)
Ability to resync data"

I think I now found what you mean in the release notes.

No, I did not clone the entry. I just changed and saved it. Somehow I have not seen this in the release notes.

Sorry.
